title: Vote on the S.P.H.E.R.E. logo concepts
description: Keep or drop, rate 1 to 10 and comment on 109 logo concepts for Project S.P.H.E.R.E., or remix one with an AI prompt and add it to the pool.
hub_blurb: 109 logo concepts from six design rounds. Keep or drop each one, rate it 1 to 10, leave a note, or remix a mark with a text prompt and enter it into the vote.
label: Brand
sets: Eighteen broad directions: standing waves, Chladni patterns, copper shells, scan lines and a type-only wordmark.
Halftone spheres, open networks and interference patterns.
Apparatus, geometry and phase-and-motion ideas drawn from the lab equipment.
Combinations of the earlier favorites, including iris and mesh forms.
Wave-dot fields, faceted forms and multi-sphere arrangements.
